items.title: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah unveils ‘Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047’ and launches various development projects in Itanagar

items.summary: Small hydropower uses the natural flow of rivers and canals to generate clean, reliable electricity. In India, projects with capacity up to 25 MW fall within this category. They suit hilly, remote areas where terrain limits larger projects and grid reach. India has an identified potential of 21,134 MW across 7,133 sites, of which about a quarter is harnessed. These projects need little land,…
items.title: Harnessing Small Hydro Power
